findings.governingReading: not things one can keep producing or drawing out one after another
findings.explanation: The English asserts creation where Rin only observes repeated retrieval or production.

findings.evidenceJa: 精霊、聖霊と同格
findings.governingReading: equal in rank to elemental spirits and holy spirits
findings.explanation: One of the two explicit spiritual categories is omitted.

findings.highlight: Heroes’ weapons which rule over all others
findings.evidenceJa: 万物に君臨してきた英雄の武器
findings.governingReading: the weapons of heroes who once ruled over all creation
findings.explanation: Rule over all things belongs to the heroes, but the English assigns it to their weapons.

findings.evidenceJa: 言うなれば魔術と同じだ
findings.governingReading: in a manner of speaking, it is like magecraft
findings.explanation: The established distinction between magecraft and Magic is erased.

findings.evidenceJa: 伝説上の破壊を再現する
findings.governingReading: reproduce the destruction recorded in legend
findings.explanation: The English creates an unnatural plural and weakens the compact causal explanation.

findings.highlight: The swords that Archer brought out
findings.evidenceJa: 何十と持ち出した剣
findings.governingReading: the dozens of swords Archer produced
findings.explanation: The scale of Archer’s repeated weapon production disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 名剣のようだけど
findings.governingReading: appear to be celebrated swords
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a generic quality judgment for the swords’ recognized pedigree.

findings.evidenceJa: 狸が
findings.governingReading: you sly fox
findings.explanation: Lancer’s idiomatic accusation of slyness becomes an allegation of cheating.

findings.evidenceJa: 減らず口を叩きやがるか
findings.governingReading: still running that insolent mouth
findings.explanation: Archer’s undiminished verbal nerve becomes generic nonsense.

findings.highlight: Archer hasn’t shown any of his abilities yet
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーとしての手の内をまったく見せていない
findings.governingReading: he has shown none of his hand as an Archer
findings.explanation: The English broadens the concealed Archer-class arsenal into every ability, contradicting the swordplay already shown.

findings.evidenceJa: ランサーに鬼気が迫る
findings.governingReading: Lancer to take on a demonic, deadly intensity
findings.explanation: The English turns an aura pressing from Lancer into a malformed statement about how he feels.

findings.highlight: only the fastest heroes are chosen as the lancer
findings.evidenceJa: 最速の英雄が選ばれる
findings.governingReading: the fastest heroes are selected for the Lancer class
findings.explanation: The English adds an exclusivity claim not stated in Rin’s class description.

findings.evidenceJa: 我が必殺の一撃
findings.governingReading: my sure-kill strike
findings.explanation: The defining certainty of Lancer’s attack is reduced to an ordinary finishing blow.

findings.highlight: A chill like thorns fills the schoolyard
findings.evidenceJa: 茨のような悪寒が、校庭を蹂躙した
findings.governingReading: a thornlike chill trampled across the schoolyard
findings.explanation: The violent personification and destructive motion disappear.

findings.highlight: waiting to take its true form in the moment it strikes
findings.evidenceJa: 本当の姿で迸る瞬間を待っている
findings.governingReading: waiting for the instant its true nature bursts forth
findings.explanation: The English changes an imminent eruption of power into a physical transformation tied to striking.

findings.evidenceJa: まずい
findings.governingReading: Crap
findings.explanation: mirror moon exposes both a narration-like copy and a quoted copy of the same active thought, duplicating the line.

findings.highlight: the chance appearance of a stranger
findings.evidenceJa: 偶然という第三者の登場
findings.governingReading: the entrance of a third party called coincidence
findings.explanation: The conceptual punch line that coincidence itself enters as a third party is flattened.

findings.highlight: The ghastly air coming from Lancer
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーから放たれていた鬼気
findings.governingReading: the demonic, murderous aura Lancer had been emitting
findings.explanation: The English weakens the lethal supernatural pressure into vague “ghastly air.”

findings.highlight: Ever since I became the successor of Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の後継ぎになると決めた時から
findings.governingReading: ever since I decided to become the Tohsaka heir
findings.explanation: A childhood decision and commitment is changed into succession already being completed.

findings.evidenceJa: とっくの昔に覚悟していた
findings.governingReading: I had accepted it long ago
findings.explanation: Rin’s long-standing preparedness is weakened into something she merely told herself.

findings.highlight: still breathing faintly as if to give his last scream
findings.evidenceJa: 断末魔というか、まだ微かに息がある
findings.governingReading: in his death throes, or rather, still faintly breathing
findings.explanation: A correction about the victim’s remaining breath becomes an invented prospective scream.

findings.highlight: try to touch the head, facing the ground
findings.evidenceJa: うつぶせになっている顔に触れようとして
findings.governingReading: try to touch his face as he lies facedown
findings.explanation: The object of Rin’s hesitant touch changes from the victim’s face to his head.

findings.highlight: I’m ready for a day like this
findings.evidenceJa: いつかこういう日が来るだろうって覚悟してた
findings.governingReading: I had always prepared myself for the day this would come
findings.explanation: The English shifts a long-held past resolve into present readiness.

findings.highlight: The fact of his death is already determined
findings.evidenceJa: ある意味終わった事だ
findings.governingReading: in a sense, his impending death is already something finished
findings.explanation: The English promotes Rin’s defensive framing into an objective declaration that death is determined.

findings.evidenceJa: 絶対の切り札
findings.governingReading: an absolute trump card
findings.explanation: The English weakens the pendant’s absolute strategic status.

findings.highlight: make up for my lack of skill with this powerful object
findings.evidenceJa: 力ずくでこう、ガァーっとツギハギするしかなかった
findings.governingReading: force the missing parts together in one rough patchwork job
findings.explanation: Rin’s vivid description of brute-force magical patching is replaced by a generic reference to an object.

findings.highlight: It’s lucky he was still breathing
findings.evidenceJa: まだ息があるのが運の尽きだった
findings.governingReading: his still breathing was where his luck ran out
findings.explanation: Rin’s dark joke says the victim’s bad luck was being alive enough for her intervention; the English reverses it into ordinary good luck.

findings.evidenceJa: 助けただけの話
findings.governingReading: simply saved him
findings.explanation: The English adds accidental outcome language to Rin’s deliberate act.

findings.evidenceJa: ばふっとソファーに腰を下ろす
findings.governingReading: drop onto the sofa with a soft thump
findings.explanation: Rin’s exhausted physical collapse into the sofa is removed.

findings.evidenceJa: 気の抜けた溜息
findings.governingReading: I let out a deflated sigh
findings.explanation: The manner that reveals Rin’s drained state disappears.

findings.highlight: The only ones that know the Servants’ identities are the Masters
findings.evidenceJa: そのサーヴァントのマスターのみ
findings.governingReading: only that Servant’s own Master
findings.explanation: The English plural can imply Masters generally know Servants’ identities, weakening the one-to-one secrecy relation.

findings.evidenceJa: 各サーヴァントの優劣
findings.governingReading: the relative strength of each Servant
findings.explanation: The competitive hierarchy is generalized into unspecified qualities.

findings.evidenceJa: 知名度の低い英雄
findings.governingReading: a little-known hero
findings.explanation: Low name recognition becomes notoriety.

findings.highlight: an infamous hero has defeated a great hero four times in the past
findings.evidenceJa: 過去四回、知名度の低い英雄が大英雄をうち負かした事もある
findings.governingReading: in the previous four wars, there were cases where a little-known hero defeated a great hero
findings.explanation: The English changes the historical scope into one hero defeating a great hero four times.

findings.highlight: magic is pretty much useless against them
findings.evidenceJa: この連中に魔術は通用しづらい
findings.governingReading: magecraft has difficulty affecting these classes
findings.explanation: The English both collapses magecraft into magic and overstates resistance as near-total uselessness.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔法が当たり前のように跋扈していた世界
findings.governingReading: a world where Magic ran rampant as an ordinary fact of life
findings.explanation: The English uses the malformed plural “magics” and reduces supernatural predominance to widespread use.

findings.evidenceJa: 現代の魔術師が使う魔術
findings.governingReading: magecraft used by modern magi
findings.explanation: The English erases the work’s magecraft/Magic distinction and again produces an unnatural plural.

findings.evidenceJa: 基本にして優秀
findings.governingReading: fundamental and excellent classes
findings.explanation: A paired technical evaluation becomes the malformed claim that the classes are “the basics” and categorically the best.

findings.evidenceJa: 一人悶々と
findings.governingReading: brooding over it alone
findings.explanation: Rin’s frustrated, bottled-up state is flattened into neutral silent thought.

findings.highlight: consider the plans we should make from now on
findings.evidenceJa: これからの作戦予定表を組み立ててみる
findings.governingReading: try to assemble a schedule of future operations
findings.explanation: The concrete act of planning an operational schedule becomes unspecified consideration.

findings.highlight: consider what happened tonight as a tuition fee for the lessons learned
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜の事は授業料と思って諦めよう
findings.governingReading: write tonight off as tuition
findings.explanation: The English adds a redundant explanation and uses the count phrase “a tuition fee,” producing strained prose.

findings.highlight: this is one of the rules of the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: それが聖杯戦争のルール
findings.governingReading: that is the rule of the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: The English adds a hierarchy of multiple rules where Rin cites the principle her father taught her.

findings.highlight: the Holy Grail has been our earnest desire for many generations
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争は何代も前からの悲願
findings.governingReading: the Holy Grail War has been the Tohsaka family’s cherished ambition for generations
findings.explanation: The object of the inherited Tohsaka ambition changes from winning or pursuing the war to possessing the Grail itself.

findings.highlight: I cannot swear my sword to you unless I know my Master’s wish
findings.evidenceJa: 主の望みを知らなければ私も剣を預けられない
findings.governingReading: I cannot entrust my sword to a master whose wish I do not know
findings.explanation: Archer’s condition for committing his weapon and service becomes an invented oath formula.

findings.highlight: an almighty grail that grants wishes
findings.evidenceJa: 願いを叶える万能の杯
findings.governingReading: an all-purpose cup capable of granting wishes
findings.explanation: The English repeats the proper noun as a generic object and substitutes personal omnipotence for functional universality.

findings.evidenceJa: 漠然とした願い
findings.governingReading: a vague or open-ended wish
findings.explanation: A wish without concrete definition is mislabeled as semantically ambiguous.

findings.highlight: the things you value around you
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を中心とした価値観
findings.governingReading: a system of values centered on oneself
findings.explanation: Rin’s philosophical definition of one’s world becomes a collection of valued things in one’s surroundings.

findings.evidenceJa: 呆れた
findings.governingReading: Honestly, I’m exasperated
findings.explanation: Rin’s comic exasperation at Archer’s rigidity becomes admiration or surprise.

findings.evidenceJa: 肩をすくめる
findings.governingReading: Archer shrugs
findings.explanation: A deliberate shrug becomes a defeated posture.

findings.highlight: it won’t be right now[line3]wait a minute, Rin
findings.evidenceJa: 今すぐという訳でも……と、ちょっと待て凛
findings.governingReading: it will not necessarily be immediate… Wait, Rin
findings.explanation: The display control leaves “nowwait” fused together and obscures Archer’s abrupt change of subject.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとなく受け取る
findings.governingReading: I take it almost absently
findings.explanation: The uncertain, noncommittal manner of Rin accepting the pendant disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと引っかかる
findings.governingReading: Something about this bothers me
findings.explanation: A lingering inconsistency becomes the idiom for a successful realization.

findings.evidenceJa: なにより
findings.governingReading: More than anything
findings.explanation: The reason Rin treats as paramount is presented as a general summary.

findings.evidenceJa: 武家屋敷
findings.governingReading: samurai residence
findings.explanation: The historically and socially specific house type becomes generic architectural styling.

findings.highlight: the clouds start to drift fast
findings.evidenceJa: 雲がごうごうと流れていく
findings.governingReading: the clouds race past with a roar
findings.explanation: The strong wind’s audible roar disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 全身が痙攣した
findings.governingReading: my whole body convulses
findings.explanation: The involuntary full-body spasm is softened into ordinary trembling.

findings.highlight: The air around here is frozen
findings.evidenceJa: シン、と凍り付いた空気
findings.governingReading: The air is frozen in utter silence
findings.explanation: The sound-symbolic stillness that frames Rin listening for danger is omitted.

findings.highlight: I feel a small sense of an enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 確かに、敵の気配を感じ取った
findings.governingReading: I unmistakably detect an enemy presence
findings.explanation: The English invents smallness and weakens certainty.

findings.highlight: A bright white light, like a fallen sun, comes from within the house
findings.evidenceJa: 白光が、屋敷の中から迸った
findings.governingReading: white light bursts from inside the residence as though the sun had fallen
findings.explanation: The explosive emergence of the summoning light is flattened into generic arrival.

findings.highlight: The wave of power of the Servant Lancer is consumed by an even larger wave
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーというサーヴァントの力の波が、それを上回る力の波に消されていく
findings.governingReading: Lancer’s wave of power is blotted out by a still greater wave
findings.explanation: The incoming presence overwhelms and erases Lancer’s signature; “consumed” adds a feeding relation.

findings.highlight: gives the spiritual being a body, summoned to overpower Lancer
findings.evidenceJa: 幽体であるソレに肉を与え、実体化したソレは
findings.governingReading: gives flesh to the spiritual entity, which materializes and is summoned as something that overwhelms Lancer
findings.explanation: The English collapses the successive incarnation, materialization, and summoning predicates.

findings.evidenceJa: 一際強く、風が吹いた
findings.governingReading: The wind blows with exceptional force
findings.explanation: The marked increase over the preceding wind disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 踏み込んでくる剣風
findings.governingReading: A sword-wind drives in toward me
findings.explanation: The approaching pressure or cutting wind is converted into the physical sword itself.

findings.highlight: A pain in my right hand
findings.evidenceJa: 右腕に痛み
findings.governingReading: pain in my right arm
findings.explanation: The location of the Command Spell backlash changes from the arm to the hand.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも無茶な命令と行為
findings.governingReading: the recklessness of both the command and the act
findings.explanation: The English drops the action itself from the cause of Rin’s backlash.

findings.evidenceJa: 令呪が一つ減った
findings.governingReading: one of the Command Spells on my arm is gone
findings.explanation: The counted expenditure from the set is detached from its arm location and presented as an object disappearing.

findings.highlight: can blow away a house without a trace
findings.evidenceJa: 家の一軒や二軒は跡形もなく吹き飛ばす
findings.governingReading: could blow one or two houses away without a trace
findings.explanation: The stated destructive scale is reduced from as many as two houses to one.

findings.highlight: cold-hearted Death who is looking down at me
findings.evidenceJa: 手を下す、冷徹な死神
findings.governingReading: a cold reaper poised to strike me down
findings.explanation: The imminent killing action is replaced by passive observation.

findings.highlight: as I lay miserably on the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 無様に倒れこんだわたし
findings.governingReading: as I lie sprawled miserably on the ground
findings.explanation: The present-tense clause incorrectly uses the past-tense “lay.”

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも可憐な顔立ち
findings.governingReading: features far too lovely and delicate
findings.explanation: The distinctly girlish loveliness that destabilizes Rin is generalized to beauty.

findings.evidenceJa: 今の魔術は見事だった
findings.governingReading: That magecraft was splendid
findings.explanation: Saber praises Rin’s magecraft, but the English collapses it into Magic.

findings.highlight: There’s no time for me to flee or plead for my life
findings.evidenceJa: 命乞いの情も
findings.governingReading: I feel no impulse to beg for my life
findings.explanation: The English changes Rin’s absence of any desire to plead into lack of opportunity.

findings.evidenceJa: またも見惚れてしまう
findings.governingReading: I find myself captivated by her again
findings.explanation: Involuntary visual captivation becomes the stronger relational verb “adore.”

findings.highlight: If you ask for regrets, that’s it
findings.evidenceJa: 悔しいと言えば、それが悔しい
findings.governingReading: if anything frustrates me, it is that
findings.explanation: The English turns Rin’s self-correcting refrain into an unidiomatic hypothetical question.

findings.highlight: Because she’s the most powerful Servant
findings.evidenceJa: わたしを殺す最強のサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: the strongest Servant—the one who is about to kill me
findings.explanation: The defining relation between Saber’s beauty and Rin’s imminent death disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 可愛らしかった
findings.governingReading: so unbearably cute
findings.explanation: Rin’s climactic, grudging recognition of Saber as cute is replaced by generic beauty.
